preconditions.expression: all(0 <= x <= y <= 1000 for (x, y) in intervals)
preconditions.description: Each interval (x, y) in the input must satisfy 0 ≤ x ≤ y ≤ 1000.
The input list must contain between 1 and 100 intervals.

postconditions.expression: all(0 <= x <= y <= 1000 for (x, y) in return_value)
postconditions.description: Each interval in the output must satisfy 0 ≤ x ≤ y ≤ 1000.

postconditions.expression: all(x <= y for (x, y) in return_value)
postconditions.description: Each interval in the output must have a start ≤ end.
The output list must not be longer than the input list.

postconditions.expression: all(any((a <= x and y <= b) for (a, b) in return_value) for (x, y) in intervals)
postconditions.description: Every input interval must be completely contained within at least one merged interval in the output.

postconditions.expression: all(not any((a < x and y < b) for (a, b) in return_value) for (x, y) in intervals)
postconditions.description: No input interval should be split into multiple non-overlapping merged intervals in the output.

postconditions.expression: all(x <= y for (x, y) in return_value) and all(x <= z for (x, y) in return_value for (z, _) in return_value if (x, y) != (z, _))
postconditions.description: The output list must be sorted in non-decreasing order of interval start times.
